name: operator==(std::extents)
intro: Compares two extents. Returns true if lhs.rank() equals rhs.rank() and lhs.extent(r) equals rhs.extent(r) for every rank index r of rhs; otherwise returns false.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

 extents whose values to compare

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the extents represented by lhs and rhs are equal, false otherwise

summary: Compares two extents. Returns true if lhs.rank() equals rhs.rank() and lhs.extent(r) equals rhs.extent(r) for every rank index r of rhs; otherwise returns false.
